RESOLVES the targeted-search Kepler-11f discrepancy. Targeted search found P=45.375d (2.81% off, SDE=15.7); blind search finds P=46.686d (0.0066% off, SDE=192). The targeted-search result is retracted -- see docs/BUGS_AND_FINDINGS.md #3.

The shallowest planet in the system was NOT recovered by the blind search, despite being recovered in the targeted search (SDE=16.0, second-lowest in that table). Consistent with the look-elsewhere effect: a blind search over the full 0.5-300d grid tests far more trial periods than a narrow +/-5% window, requiring correspondingly higher significance for the same nominal SDE>=7 threshold to be cleared.
